title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 7: Health appointments and getting help

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Notice what each relative pronoun does. In your notes, join two short sentences about a place, document or professional; close the notes and say the combined sentence from memory.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: C'est le service qui répond aux appels.
steps.en: It is the service that answers calls.
steps.tip: Say it: seh luh sehr-VEES kee ray-POHN oh zah-PEHL

steps.fr: Voici le formulaire que la clinique demande.
steps.en: Here is the form that the clinic asks for.
steps.tip: Say it: vwah-SEE luh for-mü-LEHR kuh lah klee-NEEK duh-MAH(N)d

steps.fr: C'est la clinique où j'ai mon rendez-vous.
steps.en: It is the clinic where I have my appointment.
steps.tip: Say it: seh lah klee-NEEK oo zhay mohn rah(n)-day-VOO

steps.fr: Je parle au professionnel qui suit mon dossier.
steps.en: I speak to the professional who follows my file.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh parl oh proh-feh-syoh-NEHL kee swee mohn doh-SYAY

steps.fr: Je garde le message que le service a envoyé.
steps.en: I keep the message that the service sent.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh gard luh meh-SAHZH kuh luh sehr-VEES ah ah(n)-vwah-YAY

steps.fr: Le matin est le moment où je note les changements.
steps.en: Morning is the time when I write down changes.
steps.tip: Say it: luh mah-TA(N) eh luh moh-MAH(N) oo zhuh noht lay shahnzh-MAH(N)

steps.fr: Je cherche une consultation qui convient à mon horaire.
steps.en: I am looking for a consultation that fits my schedule.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh shehrsh ün kohn-sül-tah-SYOH(N) kee kohn-VYAH(N) ah mohn oh-REHR

steps.fr: C'est une question que je veux poser au professionnel.
steps.en: It is a question that I want to ask the professional.
steps.tip: Say it: seh-tün keh-STYOH(N) kuh zhuh vuh poh-ZAY oh proh-feh-syoh-NEHL
